itinerary.title: Delhi - Haridwar
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Haridwar. The journey takes around 4.5 hours and is loved for its scenic views. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Haridwar translates to "The Gateway to Vishnu," as this is where pilgrims start their Char Dham yatra. Interestingly, Shaivites call this place Hardwar, as Har means Shiva, while Vaishnavites call it Haridwar, with Hari meaning Vishnu. The most auspicious place in Haridwar is the Har ki Pauri, which is believed to be the Ganges' exit point from the mountains. From here, the Ganges enters the plains. It is called the Brahma Kund, as legend has it that this is where a drop of amrit fell on earth when Garuda was carrying the Elixir of Eternal Life after Sagar Manthan, or the Churning of the Ocean. Spend the night in Haridwar.

itinerary.title: Haridwar - Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit some of the major tourist attractions in Haridwar, including the Daksha Mahadev Temple, Ma Anandmayi Ashram, Parad Shivling, Mansa Devi Temple, Chandi Devi Temple, Pawan Dham, Maya Devi Temple, Parmath Niketan Ashram, Bhuma Niketan, Shanti Kunj, Bharat Mata Mandir, and the Saptarishi Ashram. Later, you will proceed to Rishikesh. This holy city is situated at the confluence of the Ganga and the Chandrabhaga Rivers. Hindus believe that a dip in the Ganga river here washes all sins. Don’t miss the Triveni Ghat Aarthi, where the three holy rivers, i.e., the Ganga, Yamuna, and the mythical Saraswathi, converge. Spend the night in Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh - Delhi
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore major tourist attractions like Ram Jhula, the Beatles Ashram, Lakshman Jhula, and Gita Bhawan. Later, check out of the hotel and head to Delhi. Spend the night in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Old Delhi to explore major tourist attractions like Red Fort, Jama Masjid, Raj Ghat, and Chandni Chowk. You can also explore attractions in New Delhi, including India Ghat, Akshardham, and Rashtrapati Bhavan. Later, you will head to the airport to catch your return flight.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi - Shimla
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi Airport, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport, from where you will be heading to Shimla. Check-in to your hotel and then proceed to spend the rest of the day relaxing.

itinerary.title: Shimla City Tour
itinerary.description: Start off the day by visiting the Christ Church, which is North India’s second oldest church. Explore the Tudor Library, which is now referred to as the State Library Shimla. Get back to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Shimla - Kufri
itinerary.description: Once you have your breakfast, leave for the resort hill station of Kufri. Regarded as a place of wonders, you can explore some of the beloved sightseeing spots in Kufri on your own, such as the Himalayan Nature Park, Kufri Zoo, and Mahasu Peak. Get back to your hotel to enjoy a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Shopping in Shimla
itinerary.description: Shimla is known for its shopping scene, allowing tourists to take home plenty of wonderful gifts and souvenirs for themselves and their loved ones. Head over to Mall Road, a major shopping centre in the city where you can shop for woollen clothes, wooden and metal goods, keychains, jewellery, handicrafts, and pottery items. You can then go to The Ridge, where you will find rugs, carpets, scarves, mufflers, jackets, and more.

itinerary.title: Depart Shimla
itinerary.description: Relish a delicious breakfast at your hotel and then leave for Delhi Airport, from where you will be boarding your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi - Jim Corbett National Park
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the airport or railway station in Delhi, our tour representatives will greet you at the airport and help you get to your resort at the Jim Corbett National Park. You can spend the rest of the day at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett National Park
itinerary.description: In the morning, get ready to experience the flora and fauna of Jim Corbett National Park. You will be taken on a jeep safari where you can lay your eyes on wildlife such as tigers, leopards, elephants, jackals, rabbits, langurs, and more. Spend the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett National Park - Nainital
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be making your way to Nainital. Known as the ‘The City of Lakes’, this quaint town is surrounded by seven hills. After reaching your hotel, complete the check-in process and relax for a while. In the afternoon, head out to Naina Peak, the highest peak in Nainital, which offers the most mesmerising view of the Himalayas. Later on, go to Naini Lake to enjoy a round of boating or a cable car ride.

itinerary.title: Nainital - Mussoorie
itinerary.description: Bid goodbye to Nainital to say hello to Mussoorie, which is lovingly called the ‘Queen of the Hills’. After freshening up at your hotel, visit some of the most popular tourist attractions in Mussoorie, such as Company Garden, Gun Hill, and Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie – Delhi - Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast in the morning, and then leave for Delhi to board your train or flight back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the Delhi airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Agra. On the way, you will visit Mathura, the birthplace of Lord Krishna. Check into the hotel in Agra and spend the night in this beautiful city.

itinerary.title: Agra - Jaipur via Fatehpur Sikri
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to view the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort. Later, you will drive to Jaipur, where you will visit Fatehpur Sikri. Some places you will visit in Fatehpur Sikri include Buland Darwaza, Panch Mahal, Diwan-i-Khas, Birbal Mahal, and Jodhabai’s Palace. Check into the hotel in Jaipur and spend the rest of the evening exploring the local markets.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out for a full-day tour of Pink City. Some of the places you will cover today include Hawa Mahal, Nahargarh Fort, Jantar Mantar, The City Palace, Amber Palace, Jal Mahal, Jaigarh Fort, Rambaugh Palace, and Ramniwas Bagh. In the evening, visit Bapu Bazaar to buy local handicrafts. Spend the night in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Delhi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Delhi. Check into the hotel and relax before exploring some of Delhi’s famous attractions, including Qutub Minar, Jama Masjid, Old Delhi, Agra Fort, India Gate, Rashtrapati Bhavan, and Parliament Building. Spend the night in Delhi.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: Today, you will visit Raj Ghat, Shanti Van, and Agrasen ki Baoli before shopping at Sarojini Market. Bid farewell to Delhi as you head to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi Airport or Railway Station, you will be greeted by our tour representatives who will take you to Nainital. Check-in to your hotel and spend the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Nainital Zoo - Hanuman Garhi
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delicious breakfast, proceed to explore Nainital. You will firstly be taken to the Nainital Zoo. Located at an altitude of 2100 m and sprawled over an area of 4.693 hectares, some of the animals you will get to see at this zoo are leopards, gorals, Tibetan wolves, Japanese macaques, red junglefowls, barking deers, and more. Witness the Hanuman Garhi, which is a religious centre dedicated to Lord Hanuman. Get back to your hotel for a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Bhimtal – Sattal - Naukuchiatal
itinerary.description: On this day, visit the city of Bhimtal and experience the beauty of Sattal Lake and Naukuchiatal Lake. Enjoy boating on Nainital Lake before journeying towards the Naina Devi Himalayan Bird Conservation Reserve. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: After having your breakfast, leave from Nainital and make your way to Delhi. Board a train or flight back to your hometown.

itinerary.title: Arriving At Delhi
itinerary.description: When you arrive at the Delhi Indira Gandhi International Airport, our tour manager will greet you and help you check into your hotel. After a quick break, you will head out for a brief sightseeing tour, including attractions like the India Gate and Parliament House. Enjoy the rest of the day in Karol Bagh shopping for footwear, accessories, and home décor items, and end the day with sumptuous street food.

itinerary.title: Delhi – Amritsar
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head out to continue with your sightseeing. You will visit iconic attractions like the Indira Gandhi Memorial, Birla Mandir, Lotus Temple, and Raj Ghat. Later in the evening, proceed to Amritsar for an overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Amritsar
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Amritsar, check in to your hotel and get some much-needed rest. After a short break, get ready for a city tour. We will cover top attractions, including the Golden Temple and Jallianwala Bagh. You will also visit the Indo-Pak border in Wagah. Spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Amritsar – Kulu Manali
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, check out of the hotel and head to Manali. On the way, you will pass through the Beas and Sutlej rivers. Don’t miss the views on Kulu Valley and the shawl factory in Kulu. Reach Manali in the evening. Spend the night at a comfortable hotel in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali – Rohtang Pass – Manali
itinerary.description: After a sumptuous breakfast, head out to Rohtang Pass. The 2-hour drive is famous for its beautiful landscapes, including lush green hills and beautiful glaciers. Drive back to Manali in the evening. Spend the night at a hotel in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali – Chandigarh
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and head out for a sightseeing tour of Manali. You will visit the Vashishta Temple, Hidimba Temple, and Bhrigu Lake. Then, head to Chandigarh to continue with the next leg of your journey. Enjoy a boat ride in Sukhna Lake and some retail therapy at Palika Bazaar and Patel Market, shopping for accessories, apparel, and handicrafts. Spend the night in Chandigarh.

itinerary.title: Chandigarh – Delhi
itinerary.description: Start your day with a morning breakfast and continue with your sightseeing. You will visit the Rock Garden, Pinjore Garden, and Rose Garden. After lunch, head out to Delhi and spend the night at a comfortable hotel in the city.

itinerary.title: Delhi
itinerary.description: After a morning breakfast, head out to catch your return train to Chennai.

itinerary.title: Delhi – Chennai
itinerary.description: Continue with your train journey, enjoying the company of friends.

itinerary.title: Chennai
itinerary.description: Arrive in Chennai with unforgettable memories of your tour.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Nainital
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Nainital, our tour manager will welcome you and drive you to Nainital. The journey takes around 7 hours and is breathtakingly beautiful. Check into the hotel and spend some time relaxing. Later in the evening, enjoy a boat ride on Naini Lake. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: Today, you will explore Nainital. Some of the attractions you will visit include Sattal Lake, Bhimtal Lake, and the Naina Devi Temple, which is located on the edge of Naini Lake. Don’t miss shopping at Mall Road or a ropeway ride on Gun Hill. Spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Ranikhet Full Day Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to Ranikhet for a full-day tour of this beautiful hill station. Ranikhet is a trekker’s paradise, famous for its apple and peach orchards. When in Ranikhet, don’t miss the Jhula Devi Temple. Enjoy a Pahari lunch in the afternoon at one of the many local restaurants. Return to your hotel to spend the night in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital – Delhi
itinerary.description: After breakfast in Nainital, check out of the hotel and head to Delhi to catch your train or flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi - Manali
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi Airport, you will be greeted by our tour representative, who will help you transfer to Manali. Once the check-in formalities are complete, you can spend the rest of the day at leisure.

itinerary.title: Manali – Rohtang Pass - Manali
itinerary.description: Get ready for one of the most thrilling experiences of your life, because today you will be journeying up Rohtang Pass. Famous for being one of the most visited spots in all of Himachal Pradesh, it is located about 51 km from Manali. Once you reach the highest point, you can enjoy the breathtaking view and get plenty of pictures taken.

itinerary.title: Manali
itinerary.description: During the day, you can visit the revered temples in Manali, including the Hadimba Devi Temple and Vashisht Temple. Relax in the evening and spend the night at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Manali – Kullu - Manali
itinerary.description: Make your way to the pristine town of Kullu. On the way, view the Beas River, Sutlej River, and Kullu Valley. Make sure to shop for shawls while you’re in Kullu. Drive back to Manali and get back to your hotel in the evening.

itinerary.title: Manali
itinerary.description: Today can be spent however you want to. You could lounge around your hotel or even step out to indulge in some retail therapy.

itinerary.title: Manali – Delhi – Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: After having breakfast at the hotel, you will be driven to the airport in Delhi, where you can board your flight back home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi - Jaipur
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Delhi Airport/Railway Station, our tour representatives will greet you and help you transfer to Jaipur, the Pink City. While you’re on your way, make a stop at Amber Fort, situated in Amer, where you can enjoy an elephant ride. After reaching Jaipur, check-in to your hotel and travel around the nearby sightseeing spots.

itinerary.title: Jaipur City Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast and then venture out to witness the beautiful sites of Jaipur. There is the City Palace, which is a royal residence and former administrative headquarters of Jaipur’s rulers. Take in the spellbinding beauty of Hawa Mahal, a structure that is made up of red and pink sandstone. You will also be taken to the UNESCO World Heritage Site known as Jantar Mantar. The other spots you will be exploring in Jaipur today are the Tomb of Salim Chishti and Albert Hall Museum. Later in the day, drive to the town of Pushkar where you can visit Pushkar Lake and the revered Brahma Temple.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Udaipur
itinerary.description: In the morning, drive from Jaipur to Udaipur. On reaching Udaipur, check-in to your hotel and relax for a while. The first spot you will be taken to is Jagdish Temple, a temple that was built in 1651 during the reign of Maharana Jagat Singh. Explore the gorgeous Saheliyon Ki Bari and enjoy the view of Lake Pichola.

itinerary.title: Udaipur – Mount Abu
itinerary.description: On this day, drive from Udaipur to Mount Abu. Perched on a high rocky plateau and surrounded by greenery, Mount Abu offers just the kind of ambience that honeymooners can relish. After getting done with the check-in process at your hotel, the places you will be visiting in Mount Abu are the Dilwara Temples, Sunset Point, and Nakki Lake.

itinerary.title: Mount Abu – Delhi - Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: In the morning, drive from Mount Abu to Delhi after having your breakfast. Reach the airport or railway station to go back to your hometown.

packages.name: Special Delhi Mathura Vrindavan Package
packages.destination: Delhi - Vrindavan - Mathura - Gokul - Mahavan - Govardhan - Nandgaon - Barsana

itinerary.title: Delhi - Vrindavan - Mathura
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at the Delhi Airport, our tour manager will welcome you and help you transfer to Vrindavan, believed to be the place where Lord Krishna spent his childhood. You will visit the Banke Bihari Temple, Prem Mandir, and the ISKCON Temple here. The Banke Bihari Temple is believed to have been established by Swami Haridas, the guru of Tansen. Later, proceed to Rangnath Ji Temple, which is dedicated to Lord Vishnu and Lakshmi Devi. Move to Mathura to enjoy a delectable vegetarian lunch. In the evening, you will visit the Dwarkadhish Temple, built by Seth Gokul Das Parikh and end the day with a Yamuna ji ki aarthi. End the day at a luxury hotel in Mathura.

itinerary.title: Mathura - Gokul - Mahavan - Govardhan - Mathura
itinerary.description: Today, after a hearty breakfast, you will head out to explore the different places associated with Braj Bhoomi. The first stop on the itinerary is Gokul, which is where you can visit the Gokulnath Temple. Lord Krishna is believed to have lived in Gokul before moving to Vrindavan, as Krishna had killed many demons, including Bakasura and Putana. The next stop on the tour is Govardhan, where Lord Krishna lifted the Govardhan Mountain. Some temples you will visit include Shri Giriraj Maharaj Danghati Mandir, Kusum Sarovar, and Shyam Kund. Continue your journey to Mahavan, where Lord Krishna played along the Yamuna River with his friends. Some places you will visit in Mahavan include Raman Reti and the Mathura Nathji Temple. Later, return to Mathura to spend the night.

itinerary.title: Mathura - Nandgaon - Barsana - Delhi
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, you will check out of the hotel to visit the Pavan Sarovar in Nandgaon. This is a sacred pond where the Gopikas and Gopas would bring the cows to drink fresh water. It is believed that taking a bath in Pavan Sarovar relieves a person from all sins. Move to Barsana, believed to be the birthplace of Radha. Don’t miss Prem Sarovar, a lake believed to have been formed by the tears of Radha and Krishna when they were separated. Later in the evening, head to Delhi to explore places in New Delhi before returning home.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Agra - Taj Mahal
itinerary.description: After you arrive in Agra, our tour representatives will greet you and help you get to your hotel. Once you complete the check-in formalities, relax for a while before heading out. Witness the magic of the Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Return to your hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: Agra – Jaipur - Albert Hall Museum - Hawa Mahal - Jantar Mantar - City Palace - Water Palace
itinerary.description: Enjoy a delicious breakfast in the morning and then leave for Jaipur. Once you reach the Pink City, you will get to visit its major sightseeing spots. Start with the Albert Hall Museum, which is the oldest museum in the state of Rajasthan. Move to Hawa Mahal, a gorgeous palace built using red and pink sandstone, and then to Jantar Mantar, a UNESCO World Heritage Site which has the largest stone sundial in the world. Wrap up the day by visiting the City Palace and Water Palace. Spend the night at your hotel in Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Delhi
itinerary.description: In the morning, have your breakfast and leave for Delhi. On the way, stop to visit the Amer Palace Fort, which was constructed with red sandstone and marble. Relax at your hotel in Delhi and get a good night’s sleep.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Birla Mandir - Lotus Temple - Raj Ghat - Indira Gandhi Memorial
itinerary.description: On this day, you will be going around the city of Delhi and taking in all the touristy sights it has to offer. The first stop will be Birla Mandir, which also goes by the name of Shri Laxmi Narayan Temple, and was the first Hindu temple to be built in Delhi. Next up is the Lotus Temple, which derives its name from the lotus-like shape of the temple. Go to Raj Ghat, a memorial complex where Mahatma Gandhi was cremated after his assassination in 1948. Finish the day by visiting the Indira Gandhi Memorial, which was once the place of residence of Indira Gandhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi - Akshardham Temple - India Gate
itinerary.description: Once you get done with your breakfast, proceed to offer your prayers at the Akshardham Temple, a Hindu temple situated in a complex filled with lush green gardens, lawns, and exquisite bronze statues. End the day by going to India Gate, a war memorial that was built to honour the brave soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

itinerary.title: Depart Delhi
itinerary.description: After relishing a scrumptious breakfast at your hotel, you can go shopping at Karol Bagh. A bit later in the day, get to the Delhi Railway Station to return to your hometown.
